## Summary

Describe the user-facing or technical change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran the relevant tests and checks.
- [ ] I did not add credentials, environment files, deployment configuration, release binaries, or
      private documentation.
- [ ] I did not add AI-agent or local tool configuration.
- [ ] I understand that changes reach `main` only through review and required checks.
- [ ] I have read `LICENSE` and agree to its contribution terms.
